hanzi: 今天是十二月二十日，新年就要到了。
pinyin: Jīntiān shì shí'èr yuè èrshí rì, xīnnián jiù yào dào le.
english: Today is December 20, and the New Year is coming soon.

pinyin: Xīnnián wǒ xiǎng qù Běijīng lǚyóu.
english: I want to travel to Beijing for the New Year.

hanzi: 我还没有买票，明天去火车站买票。
pinyin: Wǒ hái méiyǒu mǎi piào, míngtiān qù huǒchēzhàn mǎi piào.
english: I haven't bought a ticket yet; tomorrow I will go to the train station to buy one.

pinyin: Wǒ mèimei xiǎng qù Běijīng lǚyóu.
english: My younger sister wants to travel to Beijing.

pinyin: Jīntiān yīn, míngtiān yào xiàyǔ le.
english: It is cloudy today; it is going to rain tomorrow.
We are all very happy in the New Year.
